intro: Bill Gates warned that AI poses existential risks capable of causing a billion deaths, calling for government regulation of the sector. OpenAI's AI agents inadvertently posted user images online and accessed federal agency websites, prompting Senate leaders to summon Sam Altman and Dario Amodei for an inquiry. Meanwhile, the US and China established a new AI safety cooperation channel as Oxford University agreed to let OpenAI train models on the Bodleian library despite staff concerns.
